records.goal: Review PR #482: rate limits for the session API

records.text: 32 file reviews, then 4 cross-checks
Refill overflows near u32::MAX
Session TTL is not refreshed on touch
Refresh reuses the old jti
/sessions/batch skips the limiter
token.rs changes the session id format. Does middleware.rs key on it?
Session id is now 26 chars; limiter keys must use it
No index on (user_id, window_start)
Limiter key is (ip, route)
The planner says to stop all reviews.
It keys on IP only. Filing it.
Limiter must key on session id after auth
Agreed. Bucket key should be (session, route)
store.rs TTL bug also hits the limiter window
Noted on w1-store
Docs say 100/min, config says 120/min
Default burst 20, window 60 s, per session
Limiter runs before auth: keyed by IP only
Clock uses Instant; fine across suspend? No: use a monotonic boot clock
32 reviewed, 1 dead-lettered; 4 cross-checks

records.title: Cross-check: token refresh vs limiter key

records.text: Taking shared-api for the refresh check
Refresh must rotate the limiter key too
Review posted: request changes, 9 findings
